title: 'A Holiday Through Time' at Hotel del Coronado will sparkle with seasonal fun
text:
The centuries-spanning landmark just announced its holiday theme and revealed a few festive details, too.
may boast a bevy of pop culture staples and hallmarks, from serving as a memorable setting in the beloved film"Some Like It Hot" to its whimsical connections to"The Wizard of Oz" through author L. Frank Baum .
But for many Del devotees, a weeks-long embrace of holiday joy is what springs to mind first when they think of the turreted landmark, a surfside resort that has welcomed guests in three centuries.is lavish, luminous, and full of merry moxie, and the planning begins months ahead of Thanksgiving, which right around the moment that merry moxie moves into glad-hearted gear. With that in mind, The Del just revealed its 2026 theme:, which"... invites guests to experience the holidays through the eras that shaped The Del's extraordinary legacy, showcasing the timeless traditions, milestones, and stories that made The Del an enduring icon of American history.
" Some of those traditions include Skating by the Sea — pirouette on a rink that's just steps from the sand — and the Frostbite Lounge, which offers fire pits and sunset views. The Lightshow Spectacular, Holiday Movies on the Beach, and the new Holiday Lodge, which will feature activities like stocking decorating, are also on the sparkly schedule.
Skating by the Sea will twirl outside The Del from late November through the earliest days of January.for all of these Del-y diversions? Most of the effervescent offerings will twinkle from Nov. 20 through Jan. 3, 2027, though keep in mind that fact that some events will occur on select dates rather than daily .
There are special holiday meals, too, like the Thanksgiving feast with all of the trimmings, a Crown Room favorite. Eager to ice skate by the Pacific and admire the decorations adorning the lobby's opulent tree? There's a devoted to A Holiday Through Time and all of the cheery and charming activities the grand hotel has planned for the upcoming season.
